Die Leute sind super und wir würden uns sehr über neue Mitspieler freuen. Wer Lust auf eine tolle Ark-Community hat und gerne auf ASE mit coolen Mods spielen will dann kommt gerne aufs Cluster. Started playing ARK on my tablet when I was 10 years old, first video game I had ever played. Just got really attached with it emotionally. In every universe, I would choose this game to be my top 1 game of all time. This game is just so good that it makes me feel different emotions and just makes me feel so good.
Now besides my emotions,
The game itself it actually good, well at least for me, because I found out not a lot of people are a big fan of this genre of video games but personally, I find survival concept really fascinating and ARK: Survival Evolved has everything that fulfills it. 
Anyways, it will always be my best game of all time, all the memories and all the nostalgic emotions, what a journey man but its sad to see its community fall. But I will never get bored of this game.

The game has good things, a nice climate, and interesting ideas. Unfortunately, it doesn't say anything. Put you naked on the beach and left alone. No information on what, where, or when; no information on how much your equipment does damage (100%) on every weapon you made; no information about your dinosaurs in terms of what they are for—they can be useful. No information on what you should do step by step. Totally nothing. Many items are useless for solo play because of a lack of information you don't know about them. So you waste your resources, which are difficult to get. Your progress to max level doesn't give you a clue what to do. The plot is only information about creature life, history What they do and what they are hunting. No useful information. I'm not recommend a game.
